manual_checklist.title: Apply for the MAST import permit
manual_checklist.detail: An import permit from MAST is required before travel. Apply well in advance; entry without it is refused. Confirmed both by MAST directly and by APHIS: "An import permit issued by Iceland Food and Veterinary Authority (MAST) is required to import pets to the country." No USDA endorsement is required for pet dogs or cats to Iceland — see the checklist note below.

manual_checklist.title: No USDA endorsement is required for dogs or cats
manual_checklist.detail: APHIS is explicit: "At this time USDA endorsement is NOT required for pet dogs or cats to Iceland." Do not seek or pay for a USDA endorsement for this route.

manual_checklist.title: Reserve a quarantine space (≥14 days) before travel
manual_checklist.detail: Imported dogs and cats are held in quarantine at an approved facility for at least 14 days. A confirmed quarantine reservation is mandatory before travel.

manual_checklist.title: 6-month pre-export residency
manual_checklist.detail: The animal must have resided in the origin (export) country for at least 6 months before export, or since birth.

manual_checklist.title: Rabies titre timing (Category-2 origins like the US)
manual_checklist.detail: The rabies serology sample must be drawn at least 30 days after vaccination, and from a Category-2 origin (including the US) you must then wait at least 90 days after the sampling date before importing.

manual_checklist.title: Required parasite treatments before export
manual_checklist.detail: MAST requires internal + external parasite treatments within defined pre-export windows (e.g. echinococcus/tapeworm and tick treatment). Confirm the exact products + timing with MAST and have your vet record them.

manual_checklist.title: Single port of entry: Keflavík
manual_checklist.detail: Animals may only enter Iceland through Keflavík airport.
